title: Giant Propel Advanced SL 1 fourth generation mainland model
notes: Current exact mainland page identifies Propel Advanced SL 1 at a CNY 54,800 suggested price with an Advanced SL composite frame and fork, Shimano Ultegra Di2 hydraulic 2x12, 11-34T cassette, 52/36T Giant Power Pro crank, SLR 0 50 carbon wheels and CADEX Aero 700x28 tires.
